{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Indonesia|Indonesian Cuisine]]

'''Gado-gado''' is a [[Cookbook:Vegetable|vegetable]] [[Cookbook:Salad|salad]] with a [[Cookbook:Peanut Sauce|peanut sauce]] dressing.

== Ingredients ==

=== Peanut sauce ===
* 1 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Terasi|terasi]] (fermented prawn paste)
* [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|Vegetable oil]]
* 300 g [[Cookbook:Peanut|peanuts]]
* Fresh or dried [[Cookbook:Chiles|chile pepper]]
* 1 clove [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* 125 g [[Cookbook:Gula Jawa|gula jawa]] (Indonesian palm sugar)
* 4 [[Cookbook:Shallot|shallots]]
* [[Cookbook:Sugar|Sugar]]
* Fresh [[Cookbook:Lime|lime]] juice or [[Cookbook:Rice vinegar|rice vinegar]]

=== Salad ===
* [[Cookbook:Hard Boiled Eggs|Hard-boiled eggs]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* Whole [[Cookbook:Potato|potato]]es, [[Cookbook:Steaming|steamed]] or [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiled]]
* [[Cookbook: Vegetable|Mixed vegetables]] (e.g. [[Cookbook:Cabbage|cabbage]], [[Cookbook:Bean Sprout|bean sprouts]], [[Cookbook:Cucumber|cucumber]], [[Cookbook:Chayote|chayote]], [[Cookbook:Water Spinach|water spinach]], [[Cookbook:Asparagus bean|asparagus bean]], [[Cookbook:Spinach|spinach]])
* [[Cookbook:Deep frying|Deep fried]] [[Cookbook:Tofu|soybean cake]]
* Deep fried [[Cookbook:Tempeh|tempeh]]
* Deep fried kerupuk (fish or [[Cookbook:Prawn Cracker|prawn crackers]])
* Deep fried [[Cookbook:Shallot|shallot]]

== Procedure ==

=== Peanut sauce ===
#[[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] prawn paste with vegetable oil until fragrant.
#Fry the peanuts until golden brown. Remove from the pan and leave to cool, then drain off all but a little of the excess oil.
#Grind the peanuts to a paste.
# Add ground chili pepper, garlic, salt, sugar, and prawn paste to the peanut paste. Grind to mix.
# Put peanut paste in a pan, add some water to dissolve (use [[Cookbook:Coconut Milk|coconut milk]] for a richer taste).
# Add additional sugar into the peanut sauce to taste, and bring to the [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] peanut sauce until thick, and season with the lime juice or vinegar.

=== Salad ===
# Remove the skin from the boiled potatoes. [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|Deep fry]] the potatoes until golden brown, then slice.
# Wash, shred, or [[Cookbook:Chop|chop]] cabbage, spinach, and water spinach.
# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] water in a pan. Add cabbage, and cook until tender. Drain.
# Use strained boiling water to boil the spinach and water spinach, one after another. Drain.
# [[Cookbook:Blanching|Blanch]] bean sprouts for about 30 seconds. Drain.
# Peel chayote, wash, slice, and boil until tender.
# Wash and slice cucumber.
# Place the salad, sliced potatoes, fried tofu, fried tempeh, and eggs in a large plate, either randomly or in layers.
# Pour the peanut sauce over the salad.
# Spread deep fried shallots on top, and serve with kerupuk.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* Prawn crackers are non-vegetarian. You can substitute them with ''kerupuk sayur'' or ''emping'' if you wish this dish to be completely vegetarian.
* Add some ''kecap manis'' (Malay/Indonesian sweet [[Cookbook:Soy sauce|soy sauce]]) to taste.
* You may substitute the peanut sauce recipe for the procedure here.
* [[Cookbook:Cashew|cashew nuts]] is secret ingredient to make peanut sauce tastes richer.
* Some cooks like to [[Cookbook:Blanching|blanche]] or [[Cookbook:Steaming|steam]] the cabbage, cauliflower, and carrots rather than serve them raw.
* Use chunky [[Cookbook:Peanut_Butter|peanut butter]] as substitute for ground peanuts.
* Use [[Cookbook:Hot Sauce|chili sauce]] to substitute fresh or dried [[Cookbook:Chili Pepper|chili pepper]].
* [[Cookbook:Cauliflower|Cauliflower]], [[Cookbook:Green Bean|green beans]], [[Cookbook:Watercress|watercress]], [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]]es, or [[Cookbook:Pea|peas]] are sometimes included but less common.
